help: Opens Klark Morrigan's Utilities Market Condition Manager for the current supported market context.\n\nUNFINISHED: the feature ships switched off and this command refuses to open it until it is enabled on KMU's Features settings tab.

Prints KMU performance timings (call count and avg/min/max/self/total ms, what each row counted, and what its worst call was doing).

Arguments:
- tree: every section indented under the one it ran inside. The default.
- flat: every row worst self time first, named by its whole path.
- walks: only the rows that traversed the sector, worst call first.
- namespace=<prefix>: keeps only the rows whose section starts with the prefix, plus the rows they ran inside.
- top=<count>: keeps only the highest ranked rows, plus the rows they ran inside.
- perframe: divides the totals by the frames they were measured over.
- log: writes the report to starsector.log instead of printing it here.
- reset: clears the collected timings.

Nothing is recorded until the Profiling level knob on Map - Dev is turned on.
